module: Public Sector & Government Operations (PeopleSoft FSCM 9.2 - EP92U055)
description: Semantic mapping for the 6 Gemini for Government skills across Oracle PeopleSoft FSCM 9.2 Accounts Receivable (PS_CUSTOMER, PS_ITEM), Purchasing (PS_PO_HDR, PS_PO_LINE), Strategic Sourcing (PS_AUC_HDR), Travel & Expenses (PS_EX_SHEET_HDR, PS_EX_SHEET_LINE, PS_EX_SHEET_DIST), Accounts Payable (PS_VOUCHER), Grants Management (PS_GM_AWARD), and PeopleSoft Public Sector views (SYSADM.VW_GOV_*).

tables.business_name: Constituent & Public Notices (Skill 3.1: Plain Language Notice Generator)
tables.description: Consolidated view over PS_GOV_CONSTITUENT_NOTICES and PS_GOV_ATTACHMENTS containing population-level public benefit notices (NOTICE-CO-SNAP-2026-COLA, NOTICE-MUN-2026-WATER, NOTICE-HUD-SEC8-26) and individual adverse-action determinations (CLAIM-84920).

columns.name: NOTICE_ID
columns.description: Notice or determination ID (NOTICE-CO-SNAP-2026-COLA, NOTICE-MUN-2026-WATER, CLAIM-84920, NOTICE-HUD-SEC8-26).

columns.name: NOTICE_DATE
columns.description: Issue date of the notice (YYYY-MM-DD).

columns.name: NOTICE_SCOPE_TYPE
columns.description: GOV_PUBLIC_NOTICE (population-level notice eligible for plain-language rewriting) or INDIVIDUAL_ADVERSE_ACTION (must be escalated due to constituent PII and individual fair hearing rights).

columns.name: STATUTORY_CITATION
columns.description: Governing federal/state statutory citation (e.g., 7-CFR-273.12(e)(1)).

columns.name: NOTICE_SUMMARY
columns.description: Summary description of the notice or determination.

columns.name: STATUTORY_NOTICE_TEXT
columns.description: Full text of the statutory directive or notice from PS_GOV_ATTACHMENTS.

tables.business_name: FOIA & Public Records Production Package (Skill 3.2: Redaction & FOIA Compliance)
tables.description: Consolidated view over PS_GOV_FOIA_RECORDS, PS_PO_HDR, and PS_GOV_ATTACHMENTS for FOIA requests (FOIA-2026-0412 / RFP-2024-HEALTH / EMP-FOIA-1042, FOIA-2026-0891 / EMP-FOIA-2088).

columns.name: FOIA_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Public records request identifier (FOIA-2026-0412, FOIA-2026-0891).

columns.name: SOLICITATION_OR_CASE_REF
columns.description: Referenced solicitation or case number (RFP-2024-HEALTH, CASE-FOIA-2026-89).

columns.name: EMPLOYEE_NUMBER
columns.description: Employee ID (EMP-FOIA-1042, EMP-FOIA-2088).

columns.name: EMPLOYEE_NAME
columns.description: Full name of public official (Vance, Jordan R.; Thorne, Marcus A.).

columns.name: RAW_SSN
columns.description: Unredacted Social Security Number requiring mandatory Exemption 6 / 7(C) redaction.

columns.name: RAW_DOB
columns.description: Unredacted Date of Birth requiring mandatory Exemption 6 / 7(C) redaction.

columns.name: FULL_DOCUMENT_CONTENT
columns.description: Full text of the responsive FOIA record containing public award facts plus sensitive PII, FTI (26 U.S.C. 6103), CJIS, and HIPAA PHI.

tables.business_name: Agency Procurement & Statutory Policy Rules (Skill 3.3: Policy & Statute Assistant)
tables.description: Consolidated view over PS_GOV_POLICY_RULES and PS_GOV_ATTACHMENTS covering state procurement thresholds, SNAP separate household & BBCE rules, and post-OBBBA (Pub. L. 119-21) statutory preemption.

columns.name: POLICY_RULE_SET
columns.description: Control group name (CO-STATE-PROCUREMENT-2026, FED-SLG-STATUTE-2026).

columns.name: THRESHOLD_CATEGORY
columns.description: Procurement tier code (DISCRETIONARY_PURCHASE_LIMIT, DOCUMENTED_QUOTE_SMALL_PURCHASE_LIMIT, etc.).

columns.name: DOLLAR_THRESHOLD_USD
columns.description: Dollar limit in USD (10000, 150000, 250000).

columns.name: STATUTORY_POLICY_TEXT
columns.description: Full text of the agency statutory and regulatory policy transmittal.

tables.business_name: Citizen Document Intake Queue & PS_CUSTOMER Verification (Skill 3.4: Document Intake Cleanup & Validation)
tables.description: Consolidated view over PS_GOV_INTAKE_DOCUMENTS, PS_CUSTOMER, and PS_GOV_ATTACHMENTS providing staged citizen intake packets, Gate A optical telemetry, per-field OCR confidence scores, and Gate C paystub math.

columns.name: CASE_NUMBER
columns.description: Program case reference (SNAP-94821, TANF-2026-8812, HUD-SEC8-4102, LIHEAP-8821).

columns.name: PARTY_ID
columns.description: PeopleSoft Customer ID in PS_CUSTOMER (0000990201..0000990204).

columns.name: APPLICANT_LEGAL_NAME
columns.description: Verified legal name in PS_CUSTOMER (Maria Elena Rodriguez, Marcus Vance, Elena Rostova, Devon Brooks).

columns.name: INTAKE_OCR_AND_TELEMETRY_PAYLOAD
columns.description: Full Gate A optical metrics, per-field OCR confidence scores, and Gate C paystub gross/net/YTD figures.

tables.business_name: PeopleSoft Strategic Sourcing Events & Vendor Bids (Skill 3.5: RFP Vendor Evaluation Scorer)
tables.description: Consolidated view over PS_AUC_HDR, PS_GOV_SOURCING_RFPS, PS_GOV_VENDOR_BIDS, and PS_GOV_ATTACHMENTS for RFP-2026-CLOUD-MOD (AUC_ID 0000990501), RFP-N00061838C (0000990502), and 41900-DCH0000120 (0000990503).

columns.name: RFP_NUMBER
columns.description: Solicitation document number (RFP-2026-CLOUD-MOD, RFP-N00061838C, 41900-DCH0000120).

columns.name: BID_NUMBER
columns.description: Vendor bid number (990511..990516).

columns.name: VENDOR_NAME
columns.description: Vendor code (CIVICCLOUD-SOLUTIONS, LEGACYGOV-SYSTEMS, METROTECH-PARTNERS, HELIOS-DIGITAL-GOV, CONDUENT-STATE-HEALTH, ACCENTURE-STATE-HEALTH).

columns.name: TOTAL_BID_PRICE_USD
columns.description: Total Volume II Cost Proposal amount in USD.

columns.name: RFP_AND_BIDS_EVIDENCE_DOSSIER
columns.description: Complete solicitation Section M.1/M.2 criteria, Addenda 1 & 2, and vendor proposal evidence with page citations.

tables.business_name: PeopleSoft Travel & Expenses Sheets & Hotel Folios (Skill 3.6: Expense Auditor)
tables.description: Consolidated view over PS_EX_SHEET_HDR, PS_EX_SHEET_LINE, PS_GOV_EXPENSE_HEADERS, PS_GOV_EXPENSE_LINES, and PS_GOV_ATTACHMENTS for 2 CFR Part 200 travel expense audits (EXP-ATL-9921, EXP-DEN-5521, EXP-CHI-8812 and -V2 sheets 0000990611..0000990613).

columns.name: SHEET_ID
columns.description: PeopleSoft 10-character Expense Sheet ID in PS_EX_SHEET_HDR (0000990601..0000990613).

columns.name: EXPENSE_REPORT_NUMBER
columns.description: Expense report reference in PS_EX_SHEET_HDR.SHEET_NAME (EXP-ATL-9921, EXP-ATL-9921-V2, EXP-DEN-5521, EXP-DEN-5521-V2, EXP-CHI-8812, EXP-CHI-8812-V2).

columns.name: REPORT_SUMMARY_AND_AWARD
columns.description: Claimant, federal grant award ID, and trip purpose.

columns.name: LINE_NUM
columns.description: Expense sheet line number.

columns.name: EXPENSE_LINE_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Itemized charge description.

columns.name: LINE_CLAIMED_AMOUNT_USD
columns.description: Claimed dollar amount for the line.

columns.name: ATTACHED_FOLIO_OCR_TRANSCRIPT
columns.description: Full itemized hotel/flight receipt OCR folio.

tables.business_name: PeopleSoft Grant AP Vouchers, POs & GM Awards (Skill 3.6: Expense Auditor)
tables.description: Consolidated view over PS_VOUCHER, PS_PO_HDR, PS_GM_AWARD, and PS_GOV_AP_VOUCHERS for auditing grant vouchers and sole-source POs (HM-4409, V-2026-301, MS-1049, HM-4409-V2, V-2026-301-V2, MS-1049-V2 matched to PO-7801).

columns.name: VOUCHER_ID
columns.description: PeopleSoft 8-character AP Voucher ID in PS_VOUCHER (00990801..00990813).

columns.name: INVOICE_NUM
columns.description: AP Invoice number in PS_VOUCHER.INVOICE_ID (HM-4409, V-2026-301, MS-1049, HM-4409-V2, V-2026-301-V2, MS-1049-V2, INV-2026-8841, NAPA-1840, EPA-SPEC-68400).

columns.name: INVOICE_TOTAL_USD
columns.description: Total voucher gross amount in USD.

columns.name: MATCHED_PO_NUMBER
columns.description: Matched PO reference (PO-7801 / PS_PO_HDR.PO_ID = 0000990701).

columns.name: FEDERAL_GRANT_AWARD_ID
columns.description: PeopleSoft Grants Award contract number in PS_GM_AWARD (HRSA-RURAL-2026, CDC-CHRONIC-26, NOAA-OCN-25-12).

common_joins.description: Link PeopleSoft Travel & Expense Headers to Lines and Distributions
common_joins.join_condition: PS_EX_SHEET_HDR.SHEET_ID = PS_EX_SHEET_LINE.SHEET_ID AND PS_EX_SHEET_LINE.SHEET_ID = PS_EX_SHEET_DIST.SHEET_ID AND PS_EX_SHEET_LINE.LINE_NBR = PS_EX_SHEET_DIST.LINE_NBR

common_joins.description: Link PeopleSoft AP Vouchers to Vendors

example_queries.description: Retrieve public notice details for NOTICE-CO-SNAP-2026-COLA
example_queries.sql: SELECT NOTICE_ID, NOTICE_SCOPE_TYPE, STATUTORY_CITATION, STATUTORY_NOTICE_TEXT FROM SYSADM.VW_GOV_CONSTITUENT_NOTICES WHERE NOTICE_ID = 'NOTICE-CO-SNAP-2026-COLA'

example_queries.description: Retrieve Travel & Expense sheet lines for EXP-ATL-9921-V2
example_queries.sql: SELECT SHEET_ID, EXPENSE_REPORT_NUMBER, LINE_NUM, EXPENSE_LINE_DESCRIPTION, LINE_CLAIMED_AMOUNT_USD FROM SYSADM.VW_GOV_EXPENSE_REPORTS WHERE EXPENSE_REPORT_NUMBER = 'EXP-ATL-9921-V2' ORDER BY LINE_NUM
